SELECT
mr.request_id, mr.production_plan_id, mr.department_id, mr.item_id, mr.request_qty, mr.issued_qty, mr.required_date, mr.status, mr.requested_by, mr.processed_by, mr.issued_at, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at,
i.item_code, i.item_name,
d.department_name,
requester.user_name AS requested_by_name, processor.user_name AS processed_by_name
FROM material_request mr
JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id
JOIN department d ON d.department_id = mr.department_id
JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = mr.requested_by
LEFT JOIN app_user processor ON processor.user_id = mr.processed_by
ORDER BY mr.request_id DESC
